originalTitle: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets

content: Meta now lets you make your own Muse gadgets that feature the company’s new AI agent with code that the company open sourced. The company suggests projects like loading Muse on a color E Ink display to show reminders, adding it to an HDMI stick so you can display Muse on a big screen, or putting Muse on a small touchscreen device to make what looks kind of like a DIY Muse Charm. “Muse gadgets are open source devices you build yourself,” Meta says. “Program an off-the-shelf ESP32 board or set up a Raspberry Pi with our SDKs, then connect Muse to your displays, buttons, sensors, actuators, and whatever else you’ve got lying on your workbench.” However, Meta cautions that you should “Proceed at your own risk!” The company is also giving away a Muse Home Link gadget that it created. With the Muse Home Link, you use community-built skills to have the AI agent “turn on a light, control your TV, send a document to a printer, and more, depending on your setup,” Meta says. It manufactured 5,000 of the gadgets, according to Meta Superintelligence Labs’ Nat Friedman, and you can claim a waitlist spot for the Muse Home Link now ahead of shipping sometime this month. [Image: Meta’s Muse Home Link gadget. https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-02-at-2.07.16-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all]
chineseTitle: Meta 开源代码可让您制作 Muse AI 小工具

chineseContent: Meta 现在可以让您制作自己的 Muse 小工具，这些小工具具有该公司新的 AI 代理以及该公司开源的代码。该公司建议的项目包括将 Muse 加载到彩色电子墨水显示屏上以显示提醒，将其添加到 HDMI 棒上以便您可以在大屏幕上显示 Muse，或者将 Muse 放在小型触摸屏设备上以制作看起来有点像 DIY Muse Charm 的东西。 “Muse 小工具是你自己构建的开源设备，”Meta 说。 “使用我们的 SDK 对现成的 ESP32 板进行编程或设置 Raspberry Pi，然后将 Muse 连接到您的显示器、按钮、传感器、执行器以及工作台上的任何其他东西。”然而，Meta 警告您应该“自行承担风险！”该公司还赠送了它创建的 Muse Home Link 小工具。 Meta 表示，通过 Muse Home Link，您可以使用社区构建的技能让 AI 代理“打开灯、控制电视、将文档发送到打印机等等，具体取决于您的设置”。据 Meta Superintelligence Labs 的 Nat Friedman 称，该公司生产了 5,000 件此类设备，在本月某个时间发货之前，您现在可以申请 Muse Home Link 的候补名单。 [图片：Meta 的 Muse Home Link 小工具。 https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-02-at-2.07.16-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all]
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
